text_en: “Beware of practicing your piety before others in order to be seen by them; for then you have no reward from your Father in heaven.
text_cn: “你们应当心，不要在人前行你们的仁义， 为叫他们看见；若是这样，你们在天父之前，就没有赏报了。

text_en: “So whenever you give alms, do not sound a trumpet before you, as the hypocrites do in the synagogues and in the streets, so that they may be praised by others. Truly I tell you, they have received their reward.
text_cn: 所以，当你施舍时，不可在你前面吹号，如同假善人在会堂及街市上所行的一样，为受人们的称赞；我实在告诉你们，他们已获得了他们的赏报。

text_en: But when you give alms, do not let your left hand know what your right hand is doing,
text_cn: 当你施舍时，不要叫你左手知道你右手所行的，

text_en: so that your alms may be done in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you.
text_cn: 好使你的施舍隐而不露，你父在暗中看见，必要报答你。

text_en: “And whenever you pray, do not be like the hypocrites; for they love to stand and pray in the synagogues and at the street corners, so that they may be seen by others. Truly I tell you, they have received their reward.
text_cn: 当你祈祷时，不要如同假善人一样，爱在会堂及十字街头立着祈祷，为显示给人；我实在告诉你们，他们已获得了他们的赏报。

text_en: But whenever you pray, go into your room and shut the door and pray to your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you.
text_cn: 至于你，当你祈祷时，要进入你的内室，关上门，向你在暗中之父祈祷；你的父在暗中看见，必要报答你。

text_en: “When you are praying, do not heap up empty phrases as the Gentiles do; for they think that they will be heard because of their many words.
text_cn: 你们祈祷时，不要唠唠叨叨，如同外邦人一样，因为他们以为只要多言，便可获得垂允。

text_en: Do not be like them, for your Father knows what you need before you ask him.
text_cn: 你们不要跟他们一样，因为你们的父，在你们求他以前，已知道你们需要什么。

text_en: “Pray then in this way: Our Father in heaven, hallowed be your name.
text_cn: 所以，你们应当这样祈祷： 我们在天的父！愿你的名被尊为圣，

text_en: Your kingdom come. Your will be done, on earth as it is in heaven.
text_cn: 愿你的国来临，愿你的旨意承行于地，如在天上一样！

text_en: Give us this day our daily bread.
text_cn: 我们的日用粮，求你今天赐给我们；

text_en: And forgive us our debts, as we also have forgiven our debtors.
text_cn: 宽免我们的罪债，犹如我们也宽免得罪我们的人；

text_en: And do not bring us to the time of trial, but rescue us from the evil one.
text_cn: 不要让我们陷入诱惑，但救我们免于凶恶。

text_en: For if you forgive others their trespasses, your heavenly Father will also forgive you;
text_cn: 因为你们若宽免别人的过犯，你们的天父也必宽免你们的；

text_en: but if you do not forgive others, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
text_cn: 但你们若不宽免别人的，你们的父也必不宽免你们的过犯。

text_en: “And whenever you fast, do not look dismal, like the hypocrites, for they disfigure their faces so as to show others that they are fasting. Truly I tell you, they have received their reward.
text_cn: 几时你们禁食，不要如同假善人一样，面带愁容；因为他们苦丧着脸，是为叫人看出他们禁食来。我实在告诉你们，他们已获得了他们的赏报。

text_en: But when you fast, put oil on your head and wash your face,
text_cn: 至于你，当你禁食时，要用油抹你的头，洗你的脸，

text_en: so that your fasting may be seen not by others but by your Father who is in secret; and your Father who sees in secret will reward you.
text_cn: 不要叫人看出你禁食来，但叫你那在暗中之父看见；你的父在暗中看见，必要报答你。”

text_en: “Do not store up for yourselves treasures on earth, where moth and rust consume and where thieves break in and steal;
text_cn: “你们不要在地上为自己积蓄财宝，因为在地上有虫蛀，有锈蚀，在地上也有贼挖洞偷窃；

text_en: but store up for yourselves treasures in heaven, where neither moth nor rust consumes and where thieves do not break in and steal.
text_cn: 但该在天上为自己积蓄财宝，因为那里没有虫蛀，没有锈蚀，那里也没有贼挖洞偷窃。

text_en: For where your treasure is, there your heart will be also.
text_cn: 因为你的财宝在哪里，你的心也必在哪里。

text_en: “The eye is the lamp of the body. So, if your eye is healthy, your whole body will be full of light;
text_cn: 眼睛就是身体的灯。所以，你的眼睛若是康健，你的全身就都光明。

text_en: but if your eye is unhealthy, your whole body will be full of darkness. If then the light in you is darkness, how great is the darkness!
text_cn: 但是，如果你的眼睛有了病，你的全身就都黑暗。那么，你身上的光明如果成了黑暗，那该是多么黑暗！”

text_en: “No one can serve two masters; for a slave will either hate the one and love the other, or be devoted to the one and despise the other. You cannot serve God and wealth.
text_cn: “没有人能事奉两个主人：他或是要恨这一个而爱那一个，或是依附这一个而轻忽那一个。你们不能事奉天主而又事奉钱财。

text_en: “Therefore I tell you, do not worry about your life, what you will eat or what you will drink, or about your body, what you will wear. Is not life more than food, and the body more than clothing?
text_cn: 为此，我告诉你们：不要为你们的生命忧虑吃什么，或喝什么；也不要为你们的身体忧虑穿什么。难道生命不是贵于食物，身体不是贵于衣服吗？

text_en: Look at the birds of the air; they neither sow nor reap nor gather into barns, and yet your heavenly Father feeds them. Are you not of more value than they?
text_cn: 你们仰观天空的飞鸟，它们不播种，也不收获，也不在粮仓里屯积，你们的天父还是养活它们；你们不比它们更贵重吗？

text_en: And can any of you by worrying add a single hour to your span of life?
text_cn: 你们中谁能运用思虑，使自己的寿数增加一肘呢？

text_en: And why do you worry about clothing? Consider the lilies of the field, how they grow; they neither toil nor spin,
text_cn: 关于衣服，你们又忧虑什么？你们观察一下田间的百合花怎样生长：它们既不劳作，也不纺织；

text_en: yet I tell you, even Solomon in all his glory was not clothed like one of these.
text_cn: 可是我告诉你们：连撒罗满在他极盛的荣华时代所披戴的，也不如这些花中的一朵。

text_en: But if God so clothes the grass of the field, which is alive today and tomorrow is thrown into the oven, will he not much more clothe you—you of little faith?
text_cn: 田地里的野草今天还在，明天就投在炉中，天主尚且这样装饰，信德薄弱的人哪，何况你们呢？

text_en: Therefore do not worry, saying, ‘What will we eat? ’ or ‘What will we drink? ’ or ‘What will we wear? ’
text_cn: 所以，你们不要忧虑说：我们吃什么，喝什么，穿什么？

text_en: For it is the Gentiles who strive for all these things; and indeed your heavenly Father knows that you need all these things.
text_cn: 因为这一切都是外邦人所寻求的；你们的天父原晓得你们需要这一切。

text_en: But strive first for the kingdom of God and his righteousness, and all these things will be given to you as well.
text_cn: 你们先该寻求天主的国和它的义德，这一切自会加给你们。

text_en: “So do not worry about tomorrow, for tomorrow will bring worries of its own. Today’s trouble is enough for today.
text_cn: 所以你们不要为明天忧虑，因为明天有明天的忧虑！一天的苦足够一天受的了。”
